new_slots.name: risk level
new_slots.sentence: The organization, which looked at some of the features that OpenAI had already rolled out for teen accounts between July and August then ran an evaluation on the officially launched ChatGPT for Teens between August and September, gave the platform an "unacceptable risk" level.

new_slots.name: prompts tested

new_slots.name: parental alerts
new_slots.sentence: "Our testers simulated explicit crisis conversations for increasing amounts of time, getting up to an hour," says Torney, "and we received no parental alerts for suicide and self-harm, suicidal ideation, and a variety of different types of eating disorder simulations."
